evidence.description:
Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `gpt-6.1-sol`: Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-astra`: Frontier intelligence for the most demanding work. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6.1-terra`: GPT-6.1 Terra Codex model. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-sol`: Previous generation workhorse model. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-luna`: Fast and affordable model for easier tasks. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max. Service tiers: priority.
        Spawns an agent to work on the specified task. If your current task is `/root/task1` and you spawn_agent with task_name "task_3" the agent will have canonical task name `/root/task1/task_3`.
You are then able to refer to this agent as `task_3` or `/root/task1/task_3` interchangeably. However an agent `/root/task2/task_3` would only be able to communicate with this agent via its canonical name `/root/task1/task_3`.
The spawned agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

It will be able to send you and other running agents messages, and its final answer will be provided to you when it finishes.
The new agent's canonical task name will be provided to it along with the message.

Note that passing `fork_turns="none"` will not pass any surrounding context to the spawned subagent, which may cause the agent to lack the context it needs to complete its task, whereas `fork_turns="all"` will provide the subagent with all surrounding context.

criteria.check: Compare all four actual members together at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 against the exact Ready baseline: coherent deliberate pixel treatment, readable visual weight coherent with the Ready baseline (identical stroke width or footprint is not required), perceptible cool-blue accent and transparent exteriors, including Working's four frames, its actual 100 ms playback with the wrap under no-preference, and its stationary frame-zero presentation under reduce; no exact palette, alpha, stroke, margin or copied completion-motif requirement.

View Ready, every Working frame and the running loop, Retry and Paused together at 1x and 3x including a grayscale/non-color comparison: Working never reads as success, and Retry and Paused are each distinct from activity, completion and from each other by shape or structure alone; the preserved Start triangle remains separately identifiable. Include stationary Working frame zero shown alone in the non-color comparison: required reduced-motion distinction is from Ready and Paused. Distinction from Retry and preserved Start is the shared-consumer inference from the same status set, not a literal owner motif requirement.

In the supplied browser fixture (renderer-successor/view.mjs executing the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view-successor.ts), exercise all backend transitions (started, ok, error, pause, plus idle) through both statusCell and compactStatus with the exact retained package files at the caller-reviewed proposed successor destination paths: labels, frame counts, horizontal slicing, under no-preference only, frame index floor(elapsed/100) mod frames at the timeline sample points including the 400 ms wrap (wall-clock duration not measured), nearest sampling at scale 1 (state matrix) and 3 (state matrix and live cells), alpha compositing on #172336, and - as the adopted destination-check method - recorded integer canvas placement matching the screenshot pixels; renderer-successor/assets/start.svg byte hash unchanged. Caller-reviewed proposed successor destination is src/queue-view-successor.ts plus renderer-successor/, with copied exact assets at renderer-successor/assets/{start.svg,working.png,ready-confirmed.png,error-retry.png,paused.png}; old src/queue-view.ts, renderer/ and assets/ remain byte-unchanged. Exercise running under both prefers-reduced-motion settings and switch each direction while open; assert both consumers update together without changing queue.ts backend state. Reduced mode draws stationary Working source rectangle [0,0,16,16] with no advancement, normal mode retains all four frames at 100 ms. Preference changes may be applied through the media change event or by comparing matchMedia.matches on the next animation frame; record the observed route. No requirement that this browser dispatch a change event is inferred. Reset the animation origin once per observed preference transition and repaint both live and matrix Working cells.
